title: Minimax Regret for Budgeted Policy Learning Transported from Trial to Target
banked_reason: D0.5 kernel_substituted: promised all-regime positive-tolerance frontier, attaining rule, and converse were not delivered; validity gate confirms no bounded same-topic repair.
gap_reasons: The delivered note does not characterize the advertised finite-sample positive-tolerance frontier for general unknown source masses, effects, and dimension.
The no-universal-two-cell theorem merely refutes the proposed scalar reduction and does not replace it with a full multivariate frontier or an attaining general procedure.

The proposal's all-regime exact positive-tolerance minimax frontier, observable attaining rule, and matching converse are not delivered: the current kernel instead rules out one universal two-cell route and supplies strict-budget/boundary/consistency results, so its headline positioning must be reduced or the missing frontier supplied.
proof_attempt_summary: The run pursued an all-regime two-source positive-tolerance regret frontier with an observable safe attaining allocation and a matching converse. Discovery established a matched strict-budget rate, consistency criteria, a known-source threshold, and restricted exact results, while its negative two-cell theorem ruled out one proposed reduction. D0.5 found that these results do not resolve the general unknown-source frontier; an independent validity gate confirmed there is no bounded faithful same-topic repair. Two local citation and ranking-lemma defects also remain unrepaired.
tldr: A randomized source trial learns cellwise treatment effects, while target covariates certify the spending of a learned fractional allocation. The proved asymptotic result is an exact necessary-and-sufficient consistency criterion, not an exact finite-sample positive-tolerance frontier. Under the published one-sided overlap \(q_x\le Cp_x\), vanishing minimax regret is equivalent to vanishing source-sign complexity together with either increasing target information or tolerance approaching the one-sided threshold \(\Delta_C^{\rightarrow}(B)=\min\{C-1,1-B\}\). Under the maintained reciprocal overlap, the same criterion holds with the sharper symmetric threshold \(\Delta_C(B)\). The upper bound chooses, without splitting \(\alpha\), between a target-calibrated chain rule and an observable target-free source-chain rule scaled to the allowed surplus. The exact unknown-source positive-tolerance value remains unresolved; the strict-budget rate, exact known-source binomial rule, equality face \(C=1\), and finite profile programs remain certified reductions and diagnostics.
gap: Existing transported policy learning estimates target welfare, and existing budgeted policy learning supplies cost bounds or asymptotic feasibility results, but no inspected paper determines the finite-sample all-procedure welfare-regret value under a uniform probability bound on target spending. Separate source and target uncertainty makes fixed confidence splitting potentially non-sharp when the relevant error probability is exponentially small.
fill: The project profiles the joint source-target likelihood along nested allocation prefixes, proves the strict-budget and known-source boundary reductions, and converts the resulting profile into an observable allocation with matching regret and safety guarantees. On \(\mathcal E_2\), the finite program \(v_{n,m}^{(2)}(\mathcal T)\) exposes every data state, nuisance constraint, randomized dose weight, and regret inequality; the \(n=m=1\) unsplit instance fixes an exact calibration target, with its additive split used only as an internal unit test. The one-sided comparison records which results survive without reciprocal overlap, and the \(C=1\) reduction pools the two covariate histograms. For \(C>1\), the lower route uses equal-weight composite priors on \(\mathcal E_3(h,\gamma)\) if the scalar comparison fails.
